chunks: And he عليه السلام said: regarding the muhrim witnessing the marriage of two who are not in ihram, he عليه السلام said: "He should not witness it."
Then he said: "It is permissible for the muhrim to point out game to one who is not in ihram."

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.بِصَيْدٍ: regarding game animals or hunted prey
key_terms.مُحِلٍّ: a person not in the state of ihram
key_terms.مُحِلَّيْنِ: two persons not in the state of ihram
key_terms.يَشْهَدُ: to witness or attend in the capacity of a witness

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a muhrim witnessing a marriage or indicating game to a non-muhrim?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings concerning the conduct of a muhrim during ihram. It states that a muhrim should not witness a marriage contract between two non-muhrim persons, while permitting the muhrim to point out game to someone who is not in ihram.
